facts.fact: ITWeb reports that the Regulator's enforcement powers came into force on 1 July 2021 after a year-long compliance grace period, and that POPIA provides fines up to R10 million and up to 10 years' imprisonment.
The Information Regulator imposed its first fine, R5 million, on the Department of Justice and Constitutional Development for breaching POPIA, according to ITWeb quoting the Regulator.

The Regulator also fined the Department of Basic Education R5 million, and the Electoral Commission and Lancet Laboratories R100,000 each, both paid; the document gives no dates for these (published 2026-09-02).
